text: ＊の　＊で　＊は　ねむってしまった！

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happened completely, often when you didn't want it to. ねむってしまった = 'went and fell asleep'.

patterns.name: 〜で (cause)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing can tell you what caused what happens next. ＊の ＊で = 'because of ＊'s ＊'.
